profile.headline: AI Systems Engineer & Full-Stack Software Architect
profile.biography: AI engineer and full-stack software architect specializing in production-grade LLM/RAG systems, 3D scanning spatial pipelines, autonomous drone GCS, and international strategic partnerships.

summary_statement: AI가 산업의 구조를 근본적으로 재편하고 있는 지금, 저는 기술적 실험에 머무르지 않고 LLM과 첨단 기술을 실제 서비스와 시스템에 통합하여 운영 가능한 비즈니스 가치로 만들어 온 엔지니어이자 아키텍트입니다.

projects.name: Metaverse 3D Scanning Drone & Data Pipeline
highlights: Architected 3D spatial scanning data pipeline for metaverse reconstruction
Implemented large-scale distributed point-cloud processing and storage optimization
Automated point cloud registration and post-processing algorithms

projects.name: Generative AI & LLM Systems Integration
highlights: Self-hosted local LLM servers (Ollama, llama.cpp) and integrated GPU acceleration (CUDA)
Built high-throughput RAG search using Typesense semantic vector indexing
Model performance optimization, quantization, and production SaaS integration

projects.name: 3D-IR Aerial Scanning Drone & Secure Pipeline
highlights: Engineered 3D LiDAR and thermal IR spatial scanning embedded drone systems
Designed secure edge-to-ground telemetry protocol compliant with defense/security standards

projects.name: Integrated Drone & EV Fleet Control Platform
highlights: Designed real-time monitoring and control backend for autonomous drone/EV fleets
Implemented WebSocket & Redis Pub/Sub low-latency streaming and telemetry visualization
Engineered real-time anomaly detection and event-based alerting engine
